answer: The reveal must open the same nebula hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the gale gate. Copying becomes a race the farming party always loses, and producing 29 original texts is the only way to fill 89 aliases; the echo log preserves both halves. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
